allow: Shell(powershell -Command "$j = Get-Content docs\data\jobs.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host ('jobs: ' + $j.jobs.Count); Write-Host ('stats: ' + ($j.stats | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)); Write-Host ('thresholds: ' + ($j.thresholds | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)); Write-Host ('candidate: ' + ($j.candidate | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))")
Shell(powershell -Command "$j = Get-Content docs\data\jobs.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $j.jobs | Select-Object -First 3 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4")

Shell(powershell -Command "$r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:8931/ -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host ('HTTP ' + $r.StatusCode + ' bytes: ' + $r.Content.Length); $j = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:8931/data/jobs.json -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host ('jobs.json HTTP ' + $j.StatusCode + ' bytes: ' + $j.Content.Length)")
Shell(where msedge 2>nul & where chrome 2>nul & where chromium 2>nul)
